biotools.summary: FlatProt is a tool for 2D visualization of protein structures, designed to complement 3D viewers by enabling standardized visual comparisons of individual structures or large sets. It utilizes Foldseek or inertia-based alignment for consistent representations and supports domain-aware decomposition.
